route_relevant_distinction: Two PDFs were inspected with locators but remained NOT_ATTACHED/NOT_CAPTURED in Zotero; opportunity sensing still lacked PRIMARY_WORKFLOW.
reviewer_objection: Do not confuse inspected repository files with Zotero-managed literature or manufacture a workflow signal.

route_relevant_distinction: PDF and live HTML content were inspected, while Zotero attachment and snapshot states remained independently NOT_ATTACHED/NOT_CAPTURED.
reviewer_objection: Preserve the distinction between live HTML inspection, immutable file identity, and Zotero-readable attachment state.

route_relevant_distinction: The first acquired PDF was readable but its embedded title did not match UniToolCall; it was quarantined and deleted, the intended arXiv identity was re-resolved, and only the corrected PDF digest entered the collision review.
reviewer_objection: A successful download and digest prove file identity, not bibliographic identity; do not mark a source FULLTEXT_INSPECTED until the intended work and the file agree.

route_relevant_distinction: The immutable handoff recorded bibliographic identity, repo-cache digest, Zotero attachment state, and human inspection state separately. On explicit read the plugin rechecked the digest, created a Zotero stored attachment, opened it in Reader, saved an annotation, pinned the source Note, and preserved the runtime-only attachment and annotation keys outside the historical artifact.
reviewer_objection: Do not backfill runtime Zotero keys into immutable acquisition artifacts, and do not equate worker full-text inspection with human reading or annotation.

route_relevant_distinction: The legacy-only builder exposed 344 canonical sources while the six current child projections contained 352. Eight later reviewed sources were legitimate immutable v2 evidence, not projection noise; they are now appended with artifact digests and CURRENT_V2_REVIEWED_SOURCE origin while the 391 legacy occurrences remain unchanged.
reviewer_objection: A source inventory used by Zotero materialization must close over current immutable reviewed evidence as well as historical runs; a display projection cannot be the only place where sources exist.

route_relevant_distinction: Daily materialization created the correct portfolio/program/history Notes, but the polling backstop initially recognized only source/claim/knowledge/problem markers and therefore could not baseline the portfolio workspace. The parser now resolves portfolio, program, legacy-run, and alignment-audit markers to their exact graph nodes without enabling containment-edge propagation or lifecycle mutation.
reviewer_objection: A visualization node that a human can edit must have an equally precise feedback identity; falling back to a generic topic would erase which portfolio branch the person challenged.

route_relevant_distinction: Across 36 current concepts, 12 became bounded source-reviewed, 12 partially source-reviewed, 6 collision-challenged, and 6 pending additional source review; every current concept has a located evidence span while all 36 old scaffold nodes remain historical.
reviewer_objection: A located worker interpretation is still not field consensus or human comprehension; keep per-node boundaries visible and require original-source reading before owner acceptance.
